story.title: The Mavericks will sell Cooper Flag's secret weapon outside the AAC this weekend
story.summary: Cooper Flagg has become a devoted eater of the iconic PB&J. To celebrate his secret weapon, the team will sell the sandwich before taking on the Clippers on Saturday
